# Known technical debt and shortcuts

<!-- - [area] <shortcut taken> — risk: <…> — fix when: <…> -->
The fixture is a private test experience, never shipped to players (D-005). "Fix when" means "only if a test specifically needs it". Each open item appears once; resolved work is listed at the end.

## Open

- [data] No session locking on player data — risk: rollback/duplication on server hop — fix when: a data-handling test needs it.
- [data] No autosave; saves only on leave/shutdown — risk: a server crash loses the session's oil — fix when: a data-handling test needs it.
- [data] Players whose load failed play unsaved without being told. Verified live 2026-10-07: a player whose stored record held 77 oil saw **0** after the failed load and got no message (the record itself was protected, see Verified) — fix when: a data or UI test needs it.
- [security] **Teleporting into a can still collects it.** The client owns its character's physics, so once a teleported position reaches the server, the server genuinely sees the character at the can. Live 2026-10-07: teleport-and-stay paid ~2.9 s after the teleport at zero latency; a 0.15 s blink teleport was rejected at zero latency but succeeded on the 2nd try under the Bad 3G preset (with jitter the new position can arrive with or before the touch). Closing this needs server-side movement validation (or Server Authority mode), which is a new system — fix when: a security test specifically targets movement exploits.
- [security] **`PickupRange` = 10 studs** (server-view distance from the can to the character's `HumanoidRootPart`). Live 2026-10-07, 2 clients, Network Simulator presets Wired Broadband (~56 ms ping), Standard Mobile 4G (~127 ms) and Bad 3G (~390 ms): 40/40 walk-in pickups collected, none missed. At walk speed 16 every pickup was accepted on its first touch (server distance ≤ ~7); at 2× speed (32, no sprint exists in the game) 3 first touches were rejected (10.4, 12.2, 10.5) and each pickup still landed 0.05–0.24 s later. Open gap: a glancing high-speed brush past a can (one short contact) is untested. Raise the range only if that becomes a real case (e.g. the game adds sprint).
- [platform] Place uses legacy chat (`TextChatService.ChatVersion = LegacyChatService`, the Rojo build default). One client added mid-test via `StudioTestService:AddPlayers` logged a `ChatScript:116 SetCore CoreGuiChatConnections has not been registered` error (a later AddPlayers client did not). Roblox's script, not fixture code. Smallest fix: set `ChatVersion` to `TextChatService` in `default.project.json` — fix when: Output noise blocks a test.
- [platform] In the final 2-client test (2026-10-07), 1 of 3 test client windows logged Roblox CoreGui errors starting with `[Roblox][CoreGui.RobloxGui.Modules.PlayerPermissionsModule] Invalid value for enum CreatorType`, after which Roblox's TopBar and PlayerList CoreScripts failed to start in that window (it reported a 0 px top-bar inset). Roblox's scripts, not fixture code; the cause is unconfirmed (possibly the unpublished place, CreatorId 0). The game itself behaved normally for that client — fix when: it blocks a test.
- [ux] Out-of-range refuel gives no feedback to the player — fix when: a UI test needs it.
- [ux/mobile] On the iPhone 7 preset (666×374), the bottom-center HUD label's left ~58 px fall inside the dynamic thumbstick's activation zone (x ≤ 266). Whether the label (a non-interactive TextLabel) blocks thumbstick touches there is untested.
- [ux/mobile] The Refuel touch button position `UDim2.new(1, -149, 1, -80)` was verified only on the iPhone 7 preset (small Jump-button layout). On large screens (tablets) it should sit below the 120 px Jump button, based on the default PlayerModule layout from memory — not checked in the simulator.
- [rojo] `Baseplate`, `Tower` and the cans still use the `Position` shortcut in `default.project.json`. That's safe while they have no children; if one gains a child, switch it to an explicit `CFrame` (see the Lamp fix below). `Lamp` and `SpawnLocation` already use explicit `CFrame`.
- [data] The **shutdown-initiated save** path (`BindToClose` itself calling `save` for players still present) has not run: in every Studio stop and `EndTest`, `PlayerRemoving` fired first (2–3 ms before `BindToClose`) and started the saves, so `BindToClose` only waited. Not reproducible in Studio without changing code — fix when: a test can produce a shutdown where players aren't removed first.
- [testing] Not tested: real touch and gamepad hardware (only Device Simulator layout, emulated touch and one emulated tap; gamepad ButtonX never pressed); real devices. Tooling notes: (1) to force DataStore load failures in a Studio test server without code changes, `DataStoreService:SetRateLimitForRequestType(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRead, 0, 0)` plus 30+ pending reads fills the queue and makes further `GetAsync` calls fail with `StandardReadGameServerThrottled`; setting the `GetAsync` type to 0 did **not** throttle reads (budget showed 0, but 40/40 reads succeeded). (2) `StudioTestService` client windows start with the **last device preset that was active** in the main window, even after `StopSimulationAsync()` (confirmed: iPhone 7 carried over once; after briefly activating "Average Laptop" and stopping, clients started as Average Laptop, 1365×768, touch off). Activate a desktop preset before launching a desktop multi-client test.

## Verified live (2026-10-07)

- **Multiplayer**, three 2-client `StudioTestService` runs (one with a mid-session 3rd client; one with both clients on the iPhone 7 preset; the final one in desktop mode with a 3rd join): per-player leaderstats/HUD, HUD/fuel sync, per-player oil isolation, cans hide/return on every client, near-simultaneous refuels capped at 100 with exact deductions, one player's death/respawn not affecting the other, leave mid-session with no server errors and the lamp loop still running.
- **Real DataStore (published private experience, Studio API access on):**
  - **Save and load round trip** (solo, the tester's own account key): no record → loaded 0 → collected oil → stop saved `{"Oil":20}` (v1) → next session loaded **20** → collected to 30 (steady, away from cans) → stop saved `{"Oil":30}` (v2).
  - **Failed load doesn't overwrite real data:** with the test server's StandardRead limit set to 0 and the queue full, a joining player's 3 load attempts all failed (`DataService: load failed for Player3 …StandardReadGameServerThrottled…`). They played with 0 oil (real record: 77), earned 10, and left after limits were restored. The record stayed `{"Oil":77,…}` at the **same version**: no write at all.
  - **`UpdateAsync` merges, not overwrites:** a marker field planted in `player_-1` mid-session survived the game's save (`{"Oil":31,"_probe":"keep"}`); `player_-2` saved `{"Oil":42}`. The code calls `UpdateAsync`; a blind `SetAsync({Oil = n})` would have erased the marker.
  - **Shutdown saves land:** a solo Studio stop and a server-side `EndTest` with 2 players connected both wrote every player's final oil ~0.5 s after shutdown began (see the open `BindToClose` item for which handler started them).
  - **Output:** no game-originated DataStore errors or budget warnings in normal play. All queue/throttle warnings seen came from the deliberate fault injection or test probes.
- **Spawn (12×12, final run, desktop clients):** 7 spawn samples (2 initial, 2 rounds of simultaneous respawns of both players, 1 mid-session join) all on the pad at standing height (y ≈ 5.6), none stacked, 25.3–34.0 studs from the lamp; E at spawn refused with oil in hand.

## Resolved (all 2026-10-07, verified in live playtests)

- **Startup and core loop:** server boot no longer crashes in an unpublished place (DataStore unavailable → saving disabled; after publishing, the warning no longer appears and real saving works); HUD no longer errors before the character exists and survives respawn; refuel is server-authoritative with no client arguments (14 malicious payloads and 50-request spam rejected or capped); only the oil the lamp has room for is used.
- **Lamp unlit at 0 fuel; hidden cans non-collidable; HUD health updates immediately.**
- **Visual pass** (not a daylight/storm lighting change; `Lighting` untouched, still default daytime):
  - **Floating lamp:** one anchored `Tower` Part, 4×27×4 at (0, 13.5, 0), top meeting the lamp's bottom (y = 27). Players are stopped by its face, not launched.
  - **Ground glow:** PointLight max Brightness 3 → **1** (`MAX_BRIGHTNESS` in `LampService`, `Lamp.Light.Brightness` in `default.project.json`), Range **60** unchanged. Chosen by measuring candidates (3, 1.5, 1, 0.6): 1 is the brightest with 0% clipped ground. Live ground brightness at fuel 100/50/20/0 = 205/171/148/132; before: 84.6% clipped, mean 240.
  - **HUD position:** label at **bottom-center**, ScreenGui `ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets`. Top-center still overlapped legacy chat by ~49 px at 764 px width. Zero chat overlap on desktop and iPhone 7; bottom-center confirmed on desktop clients at 1365×768.
- **Rojo reset the Lamp to the origin:** with the Lamp placed via the `Position` shortcut, a project-file change to its child `Light` made Rojo reset the Lamp's CFrame to (0, 0, 0). Reproduced, then fixed with an explicit `CFrame`; the same child change then left the Lamp at (0, 30, 0).
- **E while typing in chat** does not send a refuel request.
- **Can pickup validated on the server:** `OilService` requires a living character within `PickupRange` (server view), on top of the existing data-loaded gate. Before the fix, a client-detached hand 76.6 studs away (touch spoof, the Studio stand-in for `firetouchinterest`), teleports and a corpse limb all collected oil. After it, the touch spoof (also under Bad 3G) and the corpse are rejected; teleports are covered by the open security item above.
- **Refuel touch button no longer inside the Jump button:** `ContextActionService:SetPosition("RefuelLamp", UDim2.new(1, -149, 1, -80))`, applied once the button exists (setting it right after `BindAction` didn't stick). iPhone 7: Refuel 517,236–562,281, Jump 571,226–641,296, zero overlap; survives respawn; an emulated tap sent one refuel request without jumping.
- **Stacked spawn:** `SpawnLocation` enlarged from 6×6 to **12×1×12** at (0, 0.5, 30) with an explicit `CFrame`; nearest edge 24 studs from the lamp (see the spawn result above).
